messages:
omar (New Hire): hi team, starting next Wed in the UK. quick run: when do benefits start if you join mid-pay-period? i opted into private health during onboarding but want to switch to NHS-only. also i paid for an expedited visa service 150 GBP1 can i get reimbursed? my home-office allowance isn't on the first payslip.
sophie (People Ops): welcome Omar! :wave: for mid-month UK starts benefits usually kick in on the 1st of the month after 30 days. you can opt out of private health but we need a signed waiver; i'll DM the form. upload the visa receipt to the HR portal under "expenses/immigration" and tag it.
omar (New Hire): uploaded visa_receipt.jpg and added note "expedited service - please reimburse". how long for reimbursement to hit payroll?
hr-bot: Upload received. Ticket HR-EXP-2211 created. Please include employee-id in the ticket for faster processing.
rachel (Benefits): pension auto-enrol is after 3 months (first payroll cycle after). private health opt-out waiver will reverse enrollment to the benefit effective date if within policy window.
ken (Payroll): saw HR-EXP-2211. once People Ops/Benefits approve receipts, reimbursement enters payroll queue. if approved before payroll cutoff (Fri 17:00 BST) it'll appear in next cycle; otherwise the one after. home-office allowance should be added to the next pay; if it's missing after that, reply with HR-EXP-2211 and i'll make a manual adjustment.
omar (New Hire): thanks all. last Q: do i need any extra tax form as a UK employee? i
keep seeing W-8 stuff but i'm on PAYE.
sophie (People Ops): W-8 is for non-US contractors; for UK employees we'll run PAYE and send a starter checklist (P45/P46 guidance). i'll DM that and the opt-out waiver. welcome aboard! :tada:
